wikimedia-checkuser-tempaccount-enable-p:
The Wikimedia-specific description for the preference to enable viewing temporary accounts (the tool to do this is provided by the CheckUser extension). The text in en.json shouldn't be changed without discussion with WMF Legal. This custom description provides a link to the policy on the use of this tool, highlights specific details from the policy, and informs the user that by checking the checkbox shown below this description they agree to the policy.

Note: We have to use HTML bold tags in this message because it's used by the front-end JS API which does not support wikitext bold text (see https://w.wiki/EuzP#Feature_support_in_JavaScript for why).
